• Portion size: Serves 4
  • Easy

A smoky, one-pot stew of squash and butter beans with a sharp herb topping.

Ingredients

  • 2 tbsp olive oil
  • 1 large onion, finely chopped
  • 3 garlic cloves, crushed
  • 2 tsp smoked paprika
  • 1 tsp ground cumin
  • 500g butternut squash, peeled and cut into 2cm chunks
  • 2 x 400g tins butter beans, drained
  • 400g tin chopped tomatoes
  • 600ml hot vegetable stock
  • Small bunch kale, stalks removed

For the herby topping

  • Small bunch flat-leaf parsley, finely chopped
  • Zest and juice 1 lemon
  • 1 garlic clove, grated
  • 3 tbsp extra-virgin olive oil

Method

  1. Heat the oil in a large casserole over a medium heat. Add the onion with a pinch of salt and cook gently for 10 minutes until soft.
  2. Stir in the garlic, paprika and cumin and cook for 1 minute, then add the squash, beans, tomatoes and stock. Bring to a simmer.
  3. Recipe continues after advertising adslot-recipe-4
  4. Cover and cook for 25 minutes until the squash is tender, stirring in the kale for the last 5 minutes.
  5. Mix the topping ingredients with a pinch of salt. Serve the stew in bowls with the topping spooned over.
